name: Trip.com Group Limited
summary:
Trip.com Group Limited (TCOM) reported earnings of $1.07 per share on revenue of $2.31 billion for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.98 per share on revenue of $2.29 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.92 per share. The company beat expectations by 16.30% while revenue grew 20.84% on a year-over-year basis.

"Travel remains a fundamental consumer need, and we see significant long-term opportunities as travelers seek more personalized and rewarding experiences. Our strategic priorities remain clear: Globalization and Great Quality, or G2," said James Liang, Executive Chairman. "Building on this foundation, we are advancing our proprietary AI capabilities across every stage of the travel journey to accelerate G2 and unlock new opportunities for growth. We are building a more differentiated and valuable global platform for travelers and partners, positioning us for the next phase of sustainable growth."

Trip.com Group Limited is a leading one-stop travel platform globally, integrating a comprehensive suite of travel products and services and differentiated travel content.
subject: Trip.com Group Limited Beat Expectations

name: Evolution Petroleum Corporation
summary:
Evolution Petroleum (EPM) reported a loss of $0.02 per share on revenue of $24.21 million for the fiscal fourth quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.01 per share on revenue of $23.63 million. The company missed consensus estimates by 300.00% while revenue grew 14.69% on a year-over-year basis.

Evolution Petroleum Corporation is an oil and natural gas company focused on delivering a sustainable dividend yield to its shareholders through the ownership, management, and development of producing oil and natural gas properties onshore in the United States.
subject: Evolution Petroleum Missed Consensus Estimates

name: Vera Bradley, Inc.
summary:
Vera Bradley (VRA) reported earnings of $0.11 per share on revenue of $71.65 million for the fiscal second quarter ended July 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.08 per share on revenue of $65.96 million. The Earnings Whisper number was a loss of $0.02 per share. The company beat expectations by 650.00% while revenue grew 1.12% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it continues to expect fiscal year revenue of $255.0 million to $270.0 million. The current consensus revenue estimate is $265.4 million for the year ending January 31, 2027.

Vera Bradley, Inc. designs, manufactures and markets stylish functional accessories for women. Its products include handbags, accessories and travel and leisure items.
subject: Vera Bradley Beat Expectations

name: Forgent Power Solutions, Inc.
summary:
Forgent Power Solutions (FPS) reported earnings of $0.24 per share on revenue of $461.67 million for the fiscal fourth quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.22 per share on revenue of $425.58 million. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.24 per share. The company reported in-line with expectations.

The company said it expects fiscal 2027 non-GAAP earnings of $1.26 to $1.40 per share on revenue of $2.4 billion to $2.6 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $1.09 per share on revenue of $2.0 billion for the year ending June 30, 2027.

“Momentum in electrical distribution equipment remains robust, and Forgent’s products and solutions continue to gain traction with customers,” said Gary Niederpruem, Chief Executive Officer of Forgent. “We booked more than $1.5 billion of orders in the fourth quarter — an amount that exceeded our total revenue for the full fiscal year — highlighting the strength of our offerings. Our performance demonstrates that Forgent is not only benefiting from industry growth, but also gaining share and significantly outpacing the broader market,” added Mr. Niederpruem.

Forgent is a leading U.S. designer and manufacturer of electrical distribution equipment used in data centers, the power grid and energy-intensive industrial facilities.
subject: Forgent Power Solutions Reported In-line with Expectations
